locations.name: The Wall
locations.description: The immense Wall of ice stretches across the northern frontier of the Seven Kingdoms. Castle Black stands beneath it, with the King's Road running south into the Gift.

children.name: Castle Black Gates
children.description: The massive gates of Castle Black stand before you beneath the shadow of the Wall. Beyond them lies the courtyard of the Night's Watch. The King's Road stretches south toward Mole's Town.

children.name: Castle Black Courtyard
children.description: The main courtyard of Castle Black. Brothers of the Night's Watch move throughout the yard, carrying out their duties beneath the enormous Wall.

children.name: Great Hall
children.description: A large stone hall where the brothers of the Night's Watch gather for meals, meetings, and ceremonies.

children.name: Barracks
children.description: Rows of rough wooden bunks where the brothers of the Night's Watch sleep.

children.name: Armory
children.description: Weapons, armor, shields, and other equipment belonging to the Night's Watch are stored here.

children.name: Lord Commander's Tower
children.description: The tower belonging to the Lord Commander of the Night's Watch.

children.name: Top of the Wall
children.description: The summit of the Wall stretches beneath an endless sky. The lands of the North can be seen to the south, while the vast wilderness beyond the Wall stretches away to the north.

locations.name: King's Road
locations.description: The King's Road stretches south from Castle Black through the Gift toward Mole's Town.

locations.name: Mole's Town
locations.description: A small settlement in the Gift where the brothers of the Night's Watch often spend their coin.

locations.name: Mole's Town Brothel
locations.description: A small establishment in Mole's Town frequented by men of the Night's Watch.
